title: AI Market Intelligence Dashboard
short: Brings together market data, competitor launches, tenders and news into one dashboard with plain-language weekly insights.
symptom: Market and competitor information is scattered everywhere
ingredient: A market radar for brand and business teams
directions: Connect your sales data and choose competitors and therapeutic areas. Get a dashboard and a weekly summary of what changed and why it matters.
problem: Brand and business development teams collect market share, competitor registrations, price changes, tenders and news from many sources, usually in slides that are outdated quickly.
why: Late awareness of a competitor launch or tender result costs market share and weakens planning.
solution: Aggregates internal sales, licensed market data and public sources (registrations, tenders, news), detects meaningful changes, and writes a short, sourced weekly briefing per therapeutic area.
data: Own sales by product and region
Public registration, tender and news sources
limitations: Licensed market data has its own coverage gaps
Must avoid sharing confidential competitor information obtained improperly
review: Brand and business teams interpret insights and decide strategy.
